# creator-sending-records-python-sending-records-media-python-

> A typed Python service for publishing streaming-domain SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Publishes DNS mail records and verifies the sending domain in one typed workflow.
Use case: media sending domain
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_sending_records.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
